text:
```yaml
name: Code Style Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Cache Cargo
        uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: ~/.cargo/registry
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-

      - name: Format Rust code
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --all -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all

  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Format JavaScript/TypeScript/Vue code
        run: pnpm format:check

      - name: Lint JavaScript/TypeScript/Vue code
        run: pnpm lint
```
